settings.text: A structured leather carry in matte black. Hardware in gunmetal. Designed for the late commute and the long flight.

settings.title: Details
settings.content: Quiet, capable, and built to disappear into your routine. The Blackwood Carry is Velantra’s everyday workhorse in deep blackwood tones — structured enough to walk into a meeting, soft enough for the weekend.

settings.title: Materials & Care
settings.content:
Material
Premium materials with hand-finished hardware.

Care
Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Condition any leather elements every 6–12 months with a neutral cream, and keep away from prolonged moisture and direct heat.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free. If something isn’t right, reach out — we’ll make it right.

settings.title: Two Year Warranty
settings.content:
Every Velantra bag is covered for two years against defects in materials and construction. If anything goes wrong in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

After two years, we continue to offer repair service for the cost of materials. Designed to last decades, not seasons.

settings.heading: Two-Year Warranty
settings.body: Every Velantra bag is built to last. If anything fails in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

settings.headline: Architectural, All-Black
settings.body: Matte body, gunmetal hardware, sharp corners that wear soft. A silhouette for the late train and the long flight.

settings.headline: Double-Dyed, UV-Sealed
settings.body: Most black leather oxidizes to brown. Ours is dyed twice and sealed with a UV-stable topcoat. Stays black for years.

settings.headline: Brushed Gunmetal Hardware
settings.body: Hardware that won’t tarnish, won’t scratch the body. A finish that disappears in your hand.

settings.headline: Padded 16-inch sleeve
settings.body: Lined in dark microsuede, against the rigid back panel. Fits a 16-inch MacBook Pro with the cable tucked.

settings.headline: Five interior pockets
settings.body: One zip, two slip, one phone slot, one pen loop. Everything where you reach for it.

settings.headline: Gunmetal, set in leather
settings.body: Four matte feet at the base. Keep the bag off the floor, off the bar, off the floor of the cab.

settings.headline: Black, kept black
settings.body: Most black leather browns within a year. Ours is double-dyed in the drum, then sealed with a UV-stable topcoat. Five years in, it still photographs the same.
